description: This file implements image handling functionalities for the Wesnoth game, including image caching, loading, transformations, and minimap generation.

classes.name: locator
classes.description: Represents an image location, either a file or sub-file with optional position.

classes.name: manager
classes.description: Manages image cache and related settings.

methods.name: set_wm_icon
methods.description: Sets the window manager icon for the application.

methods.name: set_pixel_format
methods.description: Sets the SDL pixel format and clears caches.

methods.name: set_colour_adjustment
methods.description: Adjusts colour parameters and resets related caches.

methods.name: set_image_mask
methods.description: Sets the image mask and resets caches.

methods.name: set_zoom
methods.description: Sets the zoom level for images and resets caches.

methods.name: get_unmasked
methods.description: Returns the unmasked version of an image locator.

methods.name: get_scaled
methods.description: Returns a scaled version of an image locator with colour adjustments.

methods.name: get_greyed
methods.description: Returns a greyscale version of an image.

methods.name: get_brightened
methods.description: Returns a brightened version of an image.

methods.name: get_semi_brightened
methods.description: Returns a semi-brightened version of an image.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Retrieves an image based on locator, type, and colour adjustment, loading and caching as needed.

methods.name: get_image_dim
methods.description: Returns an image scaled to specific dimensions.

methods.name: reverse_image
methods.description: Returns a horizontally flipped version of an image.

methods.name: get_alternative
methods.description: Returns an alternative image locator based on a suffix.

methods.name: register_image
methods.description: Registers an image with a locator.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if an image locator exists in the cache and filesystem.

methods.name: getMinimap
methods.description: Generates a minimap surface from a game map and team info.
